title: Забытое меню и гнев Нагиева  (The Forgotten Menu and Nagiyev's Fury)

segments.t: In the middle of the wedding reception, Vika and Nagiyev rush into the kitchen demanding to know where the special dishes ordered by the bride and groom are. Cornered, Viktor Petrovich is forced to confess that he never wrote down the menu adjustments and forgot them completely.
И тебя, и тебя, и тебя.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'We have serious problems out there.' The meaning hinges on 'by' working together with 'problems' in spoken Russian.
'Go to hell!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'go' before landing on 'the devil'.
'Dima, what happened out there?' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'Dima' and 'what' in a few short words. Dmitry answers right away.
'I am the one asking you that question.' The grammar packs 'this' and 'am asking' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'What just happened?' Chef Barinov centers this short reply on 'to happen', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
'What do you mean we do not have it?' Notice how Russian expresses 'how' and 'there is no' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'I forgot to write it down.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'to enroll' without extra filler words.
'Oh, so you forgot to write it down!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'to enroll'.
'Please do not worry, alright?' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'and' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Dmitry answers right away.
'We will serve everything right away.' Dmitry anchors the line on 'any minute', while 'all' completes the thought.
'We will sort it out, so to speak.' In Russian, the idea of 'will sort out' flows naturally into 'say' without extra filler words.
'What the hell are you doing?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'what' before landing on 'are you doing'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
И тебя, и тебя, и тебя.
'And you, and you, and you too.' The grammar packs 'both' and 'you' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
И тебя, и тебя, и тебя.

That wraps up this scene as the wedding banquet hits a crisis when Nagiyev storms in asking where the special dishes are, forcing Chef Barinov to admit that he forgot to write down the menu changes. See you next time!
